key_highlights: ASX 200 (^AXJO) finishes week slightly higher as heavyweights in materials offset broad macro risks.
ANZ Group (ANZ.AX) reports $7.6b full-year profit, but rising mortgage arrears signal household strain.
Australian housing market enters a historic downturn under sustained RBA monetary policy pressure.
AUD/USD remains under heavy downward pressure amid domestic growth slowdown and global headwinds.
Beetaloo Basin key licence awarded, providing long-term strategic upside for domestic gas infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Miners support the ASX as iron ore holds key support levels while gold miners accelerate capital raisings.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, and FMG.AX provide index stability; gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) offer defensive shelter.

sectors.trend: Major banks post resilient headline profits, but late home loan repayments and refinancing stress are rising.
sectors.implications: Expect margin compression and rising loan-loss provisions across ANZ.AX, CBA.AX, NAB.AX, and WBC.AX.

sectors.trend: Regulatory licence milestone in Beetaloo Basin contrasts with protracted global weakness in crude oil.
sectors.implications: Favorable momentum for domestic gas infrastructure developers relative to global crude-leveraged plays (WDS.AX, STO.AX).

sectors.trend: Retail landlords face department store downsizing risks alongside Australia's largest recorded housing downturn.
sectors.implications: Pressure on retail REIT asset valuations (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); residential property developers face margin compression.

sectors.trend: Department stores and discretionary retailers struggle under elevated interest rates ahead of Black Friday.
sectors.implications: Subdued consumer spending signals earnings headwinds across discretionary retail; defensive rotation recommended.

sectors.trend: Data centre and infrastructure providers show relative strength despite global tech sell-offs post-US midterms.
sectors.implications: Selective positioning in high-demand digital infrastructure (NXT.AX) while maintaining caution on richly valued tech.

key_themes: Monetary policy transmission accelerating household debt stress and house price contraction.
Divergent commodity momentum with gold benefiting from safe-haven flows while oil and iron ore face demand headwinds.
Currency depreciation providing export earnings tailwinds for USD earners while aggravating imported inflation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn and Mortgage Arrears
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic retail banks heavily exposed to residential mortgages; favor diversified resource exporters.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Equity Sell-off and US Political Volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain beta hedges on ^AXJO and allocate capital to gold producers and quality offshore earners.
Overweight USD-earning healthcare (CSL.AX) and global miners (BHP.AX) to capture currency translation gains.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail and Commercial Property Structural Headwinds
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to retail-focused REITs and department store-linked assets; rotate into essential consumer staples.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate large-cap diversified miners with USD revenues.
opportunities.rationale: Resilient iron ore pricing and a lower AUD enhance cash flow generation and dividend yield.

opportunities.recommendation: Increase allocation to senior gold producers.
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets and safe-haven demand buffer against broader macro and market volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Target digital infrastructure and data centre operators.
opportunities.rationale: Structural tailwinds in cloud computing and AI infrastructure provide earnings insulation from domestic consumers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-multiple domestic retail banking exposures.
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising 90+ day mortgage arrears and contracting housing valuations pressure net interest margins and credit provisions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce holdings in mall-anchored retail REITs.
defensive_moves.rationale: Department store distress and retail restructuring pose leasing vacancy and rent renegotiation risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain tactical index hedges on the ASX 200.
defensive_moves.rationale: Protects portfolios against Wall Street contagion and domestic rate-lag slowdown.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 (^AXJO) is projected to consolidate within a cautious 8,000–8,300 range, balanced between resource strength and bank margin compression.
market_outlook.long_term: Equities trajectory into 2027 will depend on RBA easing signals, residential housing stabilization, and sustained Chinese commodity demand.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate trajectory
Chinese industrial production and property stimulus updates
US post-midterm economic and trade policy direction
watch_list: Major bank 30+ and 90+ day home loan delinquency ratios
Dalian iron ore and Brent crude spot prices
Pre-Christmas retail spending and consumer sentiment indices
